Third Party · Storybook

Storybook is a development tool — a separate UI where you open one component at a time, flip props, and document variants. It is not a CSS framework and not shipped to end users.

What it is

Think “component museum”: each story is one state of a component (Primary button, Disabled button, Error form…). Runs beside your app, usually on port 6006.

localhost:6006 — UI / Button / Primary

args: { label: 'Save', variant: 'primary' }

Install & first story

When to pick Storybook

Storybook is not embedded in this Learning Lab UI — run npx storybook@latest init in a practice repo when you want the real workshop.
